question: Which Mn-doped LNO generated less heat in the thermal decomposition tests, the 10% or the 50% Mn sample?
rendered: According to Figure 4c,d, the 10% Mn sample generated less heat in the thermal decomposition tests, with 901.4 J g^−1 compared to 485.7 J g^−1 for the 50% Mn sample.
